title: Sunlit Lounge Layout Planner with Energy Budget
description: The user designs a sunlit architectural lounge by positioning leather sofas around a godrays light installation, managing a fixed 'light energy budget' that redistributes as sofas are moved closer or farther from the light source. Users must arrange furniture, adjust godrays intensity, toggle material sheens, and use undo/redo to reach an optimal aesthetic score.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (via importmap from cdn.jsdelivr.net) that implements an interactive architectural lounge planner. Load SheenWoodLeatherSofa.glb and godrays_demo.glb using GLTFLoader. Place the godrays model at the center of a 20x20 unit floor plane as a ceiling-mounted light installation. Clone the sofa model 3 times so there are 3 sofas arranged in an arc around the light source. Camera: use OrbitControls starting at position (0,8,14) looking at origin. Add ambient light (0.3 intensity) and a directional light. Core mechanic — Energy Budget Conservation: maintain a total light energy budget of 100 units. Each sofa has an 'illumination share' inversely proportional to its distance from the godrays center. When any sofa moves, recalculate all shares so they always sum to 100. Display each sofa's share as a floating HTML label. Interactions (10-14 steps): 1) Click a sofa to select it (outline highlight). 2) Drag selected sofa on the floor plane via raycasting. 3) Energy shares update in real-time during drag. 4) Right-click a sofa to cycle its leather sheen between 3 levels (low/medium/high) by adjusting MeshPhysicalMaterial sheen properties. 5) Use a slider in an HTML panel to scale godrays model intensity (0.2-2.0), which multiplies all energy shares proportionally but clamps total to 100. 6) A 'Rotate' button spins the selected sofa 45 degrees per click. 7) Implement full undo/redo (Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Shift+Z) storing snapshots of all sofa positions, rotations, sheen levels, and godrays intensity. 8) Display an 'Aesthetic Score' (0-100) computed from sofa symmetry around the light source and sheen variety. Show the score in a top-right HUD. Add a ground plane with subtle grid texture, soft shadows, and a gradient sky background. Include a minimal HTML control panel with the intensity slider, undo/redo buttons, and the score display.
